name: fig_residual_workflow.jpg
caption: Computational workflow for intercept correction on five observed pairs with targets y = 2x + 3. Averaging the residuals of the fixed baseline 2x yields the scalar correction b = 3 and corrected predictions 2x + b. Evaluation reuses the same five observations; this finite calculation provides no evidence of predictive generalization.
